submit_solution_to_kattis: submit a solution file to Kattis for a specific problem with auto-detected language
login_to_kattis: log in to Kattis using username and token from a kattisrc config file
guess_language_from_extension: guess the programming language for submission based on a file extension like .py or .cpp
poll_submission_status: poll a Kattis submission URL and display real-time test case progress and final verdict
guess_mainclass_from_files: guess the main class name for Java or Kotlin submissions from source file names
